title: Ines and the Deadline
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Quentin Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
